messages:
maria: FYI we just had a SEV that involved a HW partner and the gap in our escalation path made coordination slow. Need to standardize.
ajay: Agreed. Can we define a single playbook for partner SEVs? Roles, shared channel naming, on-call handoffs.
ben: +1. The ad-hoc bridging (DM -> shared channel -> Zoom) is messy. A checklist would help.
sarah: Proposing: 1) auto-create ephemeral channel partners-<partner>-sev-<id>, 2) include partner SRE, Redwood on-call, partner PM/AM, 3) pin contact matrix and runbook.
maria: Love that. Who can own the auto-channel automation? Could be partner_ops_bot + eng-oncall integration.
partner_ops_bot: I can provision channels if you give the template. Example command: `/partner-bridge create --partner acme --sev 1 --owner @redwood-oncall` :robot_face:
devon: For SLAs, let's define initial ack target (15m), triage update cadence (30m), and rollback/escalation triggers. Keep it simple.
ajay: Also need a clear multi-org pager: who goes to partner on-call vs Redwood SRE. Suggest a contact matrix pinned in channel like:
```
Redwood on-call: @redwood-oncall (pager)
Partner SRE: partner_oncall@example.com (pager)
Partnerships PM: @maria
Support Escalation: partnerships@partner.com
```
ben: For runbook steps, something like:
1) Create channel (auto)
2) Add partner SRE + Redwood on-call + partnerships
3) Run triage within 15m
4) If not mitigated in 60m, invoke exec-level update
5) Postmortem owner assigned within 24h

sarah: We should include an optional war-room Zoom link created by the bot and a short template for status updates (what happened, impact, next steps).
partner_ops_bot: Template for status updates saved. Use `/partner-bridge status --summary "short text" --impact "token latency 50%"` to post pinned updates.
maria: Who volunteers to draft the playbook doc and the channel provisioning template? I can start the partnerships section.
devon: I can take the on-call integration and PagerDuty -> Slack hooks portion.
ajay: I'll write the engineering runbook and the automation hooks. Will add sample Terraform for channel provisioning and bot permissions.
ben: Can we run a tabletop next week with one hardware partner and simulate a SEV? Quick rehearsal = huge.
sarah: Yes, schedule a 60m tabletop. I'll invite partner reps and ops.
maria: Great. Action items: @maria draft partnerships section, @devon PD integration, @ajay eng automation, @ben coordinate tabletop. I'll also add a short checklist that partner success teams can sign off on before go-live.
ben: tagging follow-up: create a template channel name `partners-<short>-sev-<YYYYMMDD>-<seq>` and enforce retention + audit logs.
ajay: One more: permissions model. Partners get limited message delete/edit rights; only Redwood SREs can run bot commands in the channel.
maria: Thanks all — I'll create the doc in the partnerships drive and post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
partner_ops_bot: Created placeholder: https://confluence.redwood/partners/escalation-playbook (edit-perms: partnerships, eng-oncall)
sarah: moving to calendar invite now. Tabletop proposed: next Tue 10am PT.
maria: Perfect. Closing thread for now; we'll reopen in the auto channel during the tabletop. :white_check_mark:
